body.name: Uniform cumulant-GMM proof handle
body.construction: Adapt the optimally weighted cumulant minimum-distance expansion of Mesters and Zwiernik by first proving a uniform von Mises expansion for empirical centered residual cumulants over \(m\in\mathfrak M_6\), then combine uniform covariance estimation under \(P_m\) with the quantitative separation and singular-value margins.
